title: #076. Rostering with Consecutive Workday Limits & Night-to-Day Rest
subtitle: Enforce rolling-window consecutive workday caps and forbid hazardous night-to-day shift transitions in staff scheduling.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { schedule, totalCost }.
judge.m2: schedule[{p0}][{p1}] must be an integer in [-1, 2] (received {p2}).
judge.m3: Staff {p0} works more than {p3} consecutive days in window [{p1}, {p2}].
judge.m4: Staff {p0} has a forbidden Night (2) -> Day (0) transition from day {p1} to day {p2}.
judge.m5: Day {p0}, shift {p1} has {p2} staff assigned, below demand {p3}.
judge.m6: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed shift cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Valid roster, but total cost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
